notes: Each entry has a source citation and a cost range (min-mid-max). Cost ranges are ballpark from published sector reports; verify against 2-3 real vendor quotes before recommending to a paying customer. Use for MVP demo only. All costs in INR lakh. Payback years are computed from cost / annual saving in the MACC calculator; the ranges here are typical outcomes.

interventions.name: Waste Heat Recovery on Stenter Exhaust
interventions.description: Install air-to-air or air-to-water heat exchanger on stenter exhaust to preheat combustion air, incoming fabric or process water. Reduces thermal energy demand of the drying stage.
interventions.source_citation: BEE PAT Textile Sector — Waste Heat Recovery Technology Package; SITRA benchmarking studies

interventions.name: Reuse of Hot Dye Liquor and Wash Water
interventions.description: Store and reuse hot dye liquor and rinse water between batches through insulated tanks and pumps. Reduces both water withdrawal and re-heating demand.
interventions.source_citation: TIFAC Assessment of Carbon Impact at Tirupur; CITI energy audit reports

interventions.name: Variable Frequency Drives on ETP Aeration Blowers
interventions.description: Retrofit VFDs on ETP aeration blower motors so airflow modulates with dissolved-oxygen demand instead of running at full speed constantly. High-impact low-cost measure.
interventions.source_citation: BEE Technology Bank; CPCB ETP Energy Efficiency Guidelines

interventions.name: Biomass Boiler (Bagasse / Rice Husk) instead of Coal
interventions.description: Replace or supplement coal boiler with biomass-fuelled unit. Biomass CO2 is treated as neutral under GHG Protocol when sustainably sourced. Significant Scope 1 reduction.
interventions.source_citation: GIZ-SIDBI Boiler Fuel Switch Reports; BEE Bureau of Energy Efficiency Boiler Programme
interventions.notes: Fuel-switch, not efficiency. Payback depends on biomass availability and price vs coal price.

interventions.name: Rooftop Solar PV
interventions.description: Install grid-connected rooftop solar PV to offset daytime grid electricity draw. Typically 50-200 kWp for a mid-sized SME.
interventions.source_citation: MNRE Solar Rooftop Programme; IREDA Financing Guidelines

interventions.name: LED Lighting Retrofit
interventions.description: Replace legacy fluorescent and metal-halide lighting with LED across production floors, warehouses, and offices.
interventions.source_citation: BEE Standards and Labelling Programme; EESL Bulk LED Procurement Studies

interventions.name: Compressed Air Optimization (Leak Repair, Pressure Reset, VFD Compressor)
interventions.description: Fix leaks, reduce system pressure to minimum, retrofit VFD on air compressor. Compressed air is one of the most wasteful utilities in industrial settings.
interventions.source_citation: BEE Compressed Air Systems Optimization Manual; UNIDO MSME Programme

interventions.name: Boiler Condensate Recovery
interventions.description: Return steam condensate (~90 C) to the boiler feed tank instead of discharging to drain. Reduces both boiler fuel and freshwater demand.
interventions.source_citation: BEE Boiler Efficiency Programme; BSI Steam System Guidelines

interventions.name: Insulation of Steam and Hot-Fluid Piping
interventions.description: Insulate uncovered or damaged steam / hot-water piping to reduce heat loss to ambient.
interventions.source_citation: BEE Thermal Insulation Standards

interventions.name: Cold Pad Batch Dyeing
interventions.description: Switch from hot-batch dyeing to cold-pad batch method for suitable dye classes. Dramatic reduction in water and thermal-energy use.
interventions.source_citation: CITI Best Available Techniques; SITRA process comparison studies

interventions.name: Bio-Enzyme Scouring (Replace Alkaline)
interventions.description: Replace conventional alkaline scouring with enzyme-based scouring. Reduces chemical load, water use, and neutralization energy.
interventions.source_citation: Novozymes India Case Studies; CITI Bio-processing Reports

interventions.name: High-Fixation Reactive Dye Substitution
interventions.description: Switch to high-fixation reactive dyes that reduce residual dye load, cutting the number of wash cycles required.
interventions.source_citation: CITI Chemical Management Reports; DyStar / Archroma sector studies

interventions.name: Rainwater Harvesting for ETP Make-up
interventions.description: Collect rooftop rainwater and use as make-up water for ETP or utility. Reduces freshwater withdrawal.
interventions.source_citation: CGWA Rainwater Harvesting Guidelines; CPCB Water Conservation Manual

interventions.name: Automatic Dye Kitchen (Precision Dosing)
interventions.description: Replace manual dye kitchen with automated dosing system. Reduces over-dosing waste and improves right-first-time rate, cutting re-dye cycles.
interventions.source_citation: BEE PAT Sector Reports; ITMA Best Practices

interventions.name: Cooling Tower Optimization (Fill, VFD, Water Treatment)
interventions.description: Upgrade cooling tower fill, add VFD on fan, and improve chemical dosing to increase cycles of concentration. Reduces make-up water and fan energy.
interventions.source_citation: BEE Cooling Tower Manual

interventions.name: Divided Blast Cupola
interventions.description: Retrofit conventional cupola to divided-blast design, improving combustion efficiency and reducing coke consumption per tonne of iron.
interventions.source_citation: BEE Foundry Cluster Programme; TERI Foundry Sector Reports

interventions.name: Recuperator on Cupola Exhaust
interventions.description: Install recuperator to preheat combustion blast air using cupola off-gas heat. Reduces coke rate.
interventions.source_citation: Institute of Indian Foundrymen (IIF) Best Practices; BEE Cupola Programme

interventions.name: Convert Cupola to Medium-Frequency Induction Furnace
interventions.description: Replace coke-fired cupola with medium-frequency induction furnace. Higher melting efficiency, cleaner metallurgy, no coke supply chain.
interventions.source_citation: IIF Induction Furnace Guidelines; TERI Foundry Modernization Reports
interventions.notes: Major capex but transformational; enables further decarbonization when grid greens.

interventions.name: Waste Heat Recovery from Furnace Flue Gases
interventions.description: Install boiler or heat exchanger on furnace exhaust to recover heat for process water or space heating.
interventions.source_citation: BEE Foundry Cluster Programme; UNIDO Case Studies

interventions.name: VFD on Cupola Blowers and Fume Extraction Fans
interventions.description: Modulate blower and fan speeds with VFDs matched to demand instead of throttling.
interventions.source_citation: BEE Motors and Drives Programme

interventions.name: Improved Refractory Lining (High-Alumina, Lower Heat Loss)
interventions.description: Replace basic refractory with high-alumina or low-thermal-conductivity linings on melting furnaces. Reduces heat loss and lining life.
interventions.source_citation: IIF Refractory Best Practices

interventions.name: Scrap Preheating using Flue Gas
interventions.description: Preheat metal scrap using flue gas or dedicated burner before charging into furnace. Reduces furnace energy per tonne melted.
interventions.source_citation: worldsteel Steel Best Practices; IIF Melting Efficiency

interventions.name: Sand Reclamation System
interventions.description: Install thermal or mechanical sand reclamation to reuse molding sand. Reduces virgin sand consumption and waste disposal.
interventions.source_citation: American Foundry Society; IIF Sand Management Reports

interventions.name: LED Lighting Retrofit (Foundry Floor)
interventions.description: Replace metal-halide bay lights with LED high-bays. Foundry lighting loads are significant due to high ceilings and shift working.
interventions.source_citation: BEE LED Programme; EESL Industrial Lighting

interventions.name: Compressed Air Leak Repair Programme
interventions.description: Systematic ultrasonic leak detection and repair on compressed-air network. Foundries typically leak 20-30% of compressed-air load.
interventions.source_citation: BEE Compressed Air Manual

interventions.name: Optimized Ladle Preheating
interventions.description: Improve ladle preheating burner efficiency and cycle timing. Reduces molten-metal temperature drop during transfer.
interventions.source_citation: IIF Ladle Metallurgy Reports

interventions.name: Improved Insulation on Holding and Heat-Treatment Furnaces
interventions.description: Retrofit ceramic-fibre insulation panels on holding and heat-treatment furnace shells to reduce heat loss.
interventions.source_citation: BEE Thermal Insulation Programme

interventions.name: Regenerative Burners on Heat-Treatment Furnaces
interventions.description: Replace conventional burners with regenerative burners that recover heat from exhaust for combustion air preheating.
interventions.source_citation: Japan Industrial Furnace Manufacturers Association Studies; BEE Case Studies

interventions.name: Fume Extraction with Integrated Heat Recovery
interventions.description: Combine fume extraction system with heat exchanger to recover heat and preheat process water or ambient air.
interventions.source_citation: CPCB Foundry Air Quality Guidelines; IIF Fume Management

interventions.name: Refrigeration Cycle Heat Recovery
interventions.description: Capture waste heat from refrigeration compressor discharge for hot-water generation (CIP, sanitation). Turns waste into free hot water.
interventions.source_citation: BEE Refrigeration Programme; NIFTEM Case Studies

interventions.name: VFD on Refrigeration Compressors
interventions.description: Retrofit variable frequency drives on ammonia or HFC refrigeration compressors to modulate capacity to load.
interventions.source_citation: BEE Motors and Drives Programme; ASHRAE Standards

interventions.name: LED Lighting with Motion Sensors in Cold Storage
interventions.description: Replace legacy lighting with LED + occupancy sensors in cold stores. Double benefit: less light energy plus less waste heat rejected inside cold space.
interventions.source_citation: EESL LED Cold-Storage Programme

interventions.name: Boiler Flue Gas Economizer
interventions.description: Install economizer on boiler flue to preheat feed water using flue gas heat. Standard measure for boilers > 1 TPH.
interventions.source_citation: BEE Boiler Efficiency Programme

interventions.name: Steam Trap Survey and Replacement
interventions.description: Conduct steam trap audit; replace failed and undersized traps. Typical facility has 10-30% failed traps causing significant steam loss.
interventions.source_citation: BEE Steam System Optimization Manual

interventions.name: Automated CIP with Recovery Tank
interventions.description: Upgrade manual CIP to automated system with rinse-water and detergent recovery tanks. Reduces water, chemical and hot-water demand.
interventions.source_citation: FSSAI Best Practices; NIFTEM CIP Case Studies

interventions.name: Solar Water Heater for Pre-Heating
interventions.description: Install evacuated-tube solar water heater to pre-heat boiler feedwater or CIP water. Reduces boiler fuel demand.
interventions.source_citation: MNRE Solar Thermal Programme; TERI Case Studies

interventions.name: IE3 / IE4 High-Efficiency Motors on Pumps and Fans
interventions.description: Replace end-of-life IE1 / IE2 motors with IE3 or IE4 on pumps, fans and compressors as they fail.
interventions.source_citation: BEE Standards and Labelling for Motors

interventions.name: Transition to Ammonia / Natural Refrigerants
interventions.description: Replace HFC refrigerant (R404a, R134a) systems with ammonia or CO2 refrigeration for new installations. Zero GWP + higher efficiency.
interventions.source_citation: Kigali Amendment (India ratified); OzoneCell MoEFCC HCFC Phase-out Plan; UNEP Cold Chain Reports
